messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skybridge.io>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-ops@skybridge.io
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — privacy documents and PO info for Skybridge

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. We're ready to complete Redwood's procurement/privacy gate so we can turn on dedicated instances next month. Per our procurement checklist, please confirm the following so our finance team can open a PO: 

- Final DPA for signature
- Link to your latest SOC 2 summary/report
- Current list of subprocessors (CSV preferred)
- AP/billing contact and billing code to include on the PO

I've attached our supplier-side onboarding form (filled) and the preliminary PO template from our side. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — otherwise please send the DPA and SOC2 link and we'll get the PO moving.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Cloud Integrations
Skybridge.io
Attachments: Skybridge_Onboarding_Form.pdf (form), PO_Template_Skybridge.docx (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skybridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — privacy documents and PO info for Skybridge

Hi Alex — great to meet you. Welcome aboard.

I've attached Redwood's standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.4.pdf) and a public SOC 2 summary link below. The DPA includes our standard subprocessor clause; if Skybridge needs a separate subprocessor addendum, flag that and we'll review.

SOC2 summary: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/2026-soc2-summary.pdf

Next steps I'd like to capture here so we can track:
1) Alex: confirm whether the attached subprocessor CSV (you can paste a final copy) matches your internal list — we need the definitive list for our security team.
2) Laura: can you confirm PO routing and billing code? Skybridge has requested a PO — we typically need vendor tax name and billing contact.
3) Ben: once PO path confirmed, please update the deal record (SB-2026-0042) and confirm whether we should enable dedicated capacity hold-offs until PO arrives.

I've also attached a small checklist PDF with minimal evidence items we require for onboarding. Let me know if you prefer DocuSign for the DPA.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.4.pdf, onboarding-evidence-checklist.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Skybridge PO routing / subprocessor review (SB-2026-0042)

Ben/Laura — quick internal note following Alex's message. Alex attached an initial subprocessors CSV; I've asked them to confirm the definitive list but attaching their file here for your review. Key asks:

- Laura: confirm whether Skybridge's tax name ("Skybridge Technologies, Inc.") and billing contact (acctpay@skybridge.io) are sufficient for PO creation. They requested a standard Net30 PO to Redwood Inc.
- Ben: supply the billing code (product SKU / charge code) for this committed package. This impacts revenue recognition and how procurement routes the PO.
- Security check: I scanned the subprocessors list; there are two cloud infra providers and a monitoring vendor. If either has access to customer data, we may need a short assessment note. If you want, I can kick this to the security team to double-check but would prefer to avoid blocking the PO unless there's a red flag.

Attachments: Skybridge_Subprocessors_20260611-draft.csv (vendor-provided)

Let me know if you'd like me to draft the PO and send to Alex once you confirm the billing code and PO owner.

- Grace
